description:
This is a short-term fix (for 2.4). In the longer term we should fix https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/128430

The problem is that warnings.warn that are inside Dynamo print all the time. Python warnings are supposed to print once, unless their cache is reset: Dynamo ends up resetting that cache everytime it runs.

As a workaround we provide our own warn_once cache that is keyed on the warning msg. I am not worried about this increasing memory usage because that's effectively what python's warnings.warn cache does.

Test Plan:
- fix tests.

Pull Request resolved: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/128456
Approved by: https://github.com/anijain2305

Fixes #ISSUE_NUMBER
